fixture_conventions.files: Paths in setup.files are relative to the selected Projects/<slug> workspace.
fixture_conventions.brain_files: Paths in setup.brain_files are relative to the initialized main Brain folder.
fixture_conventions.captures: For each capture, create the supplied fictional content in a temporary input, invoke intake capture for its source_id/projects, and retain the returned digest/path. Replace SOURCE_LINK(source-id) with a correctly relative Markdown link to that returned path.
fixture_conventions.scope: All fixtures belong in a disposable initialized Brain folder. Scenario assertions are expectations, not evidence of execution.
fixture_conventions.registry: Scenario registry entries describe overrides on workspaces first created with new-project; retain required name/type/application fields from CLI defaults. String descriptions identify fixture conditions to realize, not literal registry JSON.
